issue.title: Audit which SDD store callers need fresh=True given ensure_workspace_sdd_clone's 120s TTL
issue.description: epic_prompt_link_race plan (sase/repos/plans/202607/epic_prompt_link_race.md, section 8) flagged this as a follow-up: ensure_workspace_sdd_clone gates its fetch behind a 120s freshness TTL (src/sase/sdd/_integration_marker.py:12, src/sase/sdd/_store_link.py:300-307). That is a reasonable optimization but it widens every cross-checkout visibility window in the SDD store -- e.g. it is part of why the host's plan-archive checkout (workspace 1) can fail to see a just-pushed prompt snapshot from the agent's own checkout (workspace N) during epic approval. Worth auditing which callers actually need fresh=True (paths where cross-checkout visibility matters, like plan archival during approval) versus callers where the 120s staleness window is fine.
